checks.after: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.
checks.reason: 家給人足 pairs provision for every household with sufficiency for every person; the current EN drops 人足, and the replacement restores it faithfully, matching the existing literal.

checks.after: Agricultural officers are carefully selected and encouragement and assessment are pressed to the utmost, so each man tends a full hundred mu without relying on ox power;
checks.reason: 高選農官 and 務盡勸課 are fixed correctly, but the proposed EN still says ‘without borrowing oxen’. 不假牛力 means not relying on ox power, as the alternative finding and companion literal repair focused-1-3 say. Restricting it to borrowing is a definite narrowing, so only that clause is changed.

checks.after: Select agricultural officers with care, strive to the utmost in encouragement and assessment; each man tends a full hundred mu of field and does not need ox power;
checks.reason: 不假牛力 means not depending on ox power, not merely not borrowing it; ‘does not need ox power’ is faithful, and the rest of the literal is unchanged and already correct.

checks.after: those who labor in the fields receive honors of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being denied peer standing.
checks.reason: 力田者 and 惰農者 are restored as field laborers versus idle farmers, 旌顯之賞 as honors of distinction, and 不齒之罰 as denial of peer standing; consistent with the pending approved literal.

checks.after: Again, assess the work to establish offices and the offices to appoint personnel, ensuring that offices meet needs and no one occupies a post in vain; estimate the annual revenue and set their salaries accordingly.
checks.reason: 量事置官 and 量官置人 are two distinct staffing rules, and 裁而祿之 sets salaries by estimated revenue rather than prescribing cuts; the replacement is faithful and matches the approved literal.

checks.after: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no two-thousand-bushel official or magistrate is intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.
checks.reason: 莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者 denies both diligence in public duty and zeal to exhaust land advantage; the current EN’s ‘works the land’ misreads it, and the replacement fixes this faithfully.

checks.after: Knowing this, Han's founder summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and under Ming and Zhang the age was called nearly peaceful.
checks.reason: 征殺 keeps summon-and-execute, 以十數 is counted by tens, and 墾田不實 and 號次 are restored; 漢祖 is kept as written, with no historical attribution resolved.

checks.after: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.
checks.reason: The literal likewise needs 征殺 as summoned and executed and 以十數 as by the tens; 墾田 and 號次升平 already present are preserved, with 漢祖 left as supplied.

checks.after: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; people wander and perish from hunger and cold, falling one after another into the ditches.
checks.reason: The proposal rightly restores 千里無煙 and 相繼溝壑, but ‘hunger and cold bring ruin’ makes hunger and cold the agents and loses 流 (drifting). That is the same defect the companion literal repair focused-1-10 corrects. 饑寒流隕 is people wandering and perishing amid hunger and cold.

checks.after: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; people wander and perish from hunger and cold, falling one after another into ditches and gullies.
checks.reason: 饑寒流隕 describes the displaced people wandering and perishing in hunger and cold, not hunger and cold flowing in ruin; the replacement is faithful and keeps 溝壑 as ditches and gullies.

checks.after: Murong Hui, by divine martial prowess and sagacious strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign peoples beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children returning to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; people were numerous, land was scarce, and four in ten had no fields.
checks.reason: 塞表殊類 is foreign peoples beyond the frontier; 神武聖略 and 人殷地狹 restore sagacious strategy and the numerous population. The existing Murong Hui label for 先王 is only retained, not newly approved.

checks.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
checks.reason: 英聖 adds sagacity, 繼武闡廣 is following earlier footsteps and expanding, and 有高西伯 is surpassing the Earl of the West, not rivaling him. Wording matches the approved literal, and ‘his’ agrees with the third-person ‘Your Highness’.
